metadata.description: Research Agora - a marketplace of verification-first skills for ML research. A skill ships only if something can check what it produced.

plugins.name: discover
plugins.description: Find out what exists and decide what to do: arXiv literature discovery with a verified bibliography, benchmark and baseline scouting, checkpoint-gated brainstorming, and a navigator that routes you to the right skill.

plugins.name: write
plugins.description: Produce and diagnose the draft: abstract diagnosis against venue limits, experiment sections built from values a script extracted, skeptical reviewer simulation, argument mapping, and prose scoring via limpid. It diagnoses what you wrote; it does not write your claims.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Check what the draft claims: citation verification via bibtexupdater, paper-versus-code consistency, statistical rigor, proof auditing, notation consistency, and parallel audit orchestration. Every skill here checks something against a source outside itself.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: The machinery around the paper: LaTeX build/debug/lint, equation-to-code sync, publication figures in TikZ or matplotlib, rebuttal triage and response, experiment tracking, cluster submission, and artifact packaging.
